name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Hold the dumbbells at your sides and rest the top of your rear foot on the bench behind you.
Brace your core and lower your hips by bending your front knee until your front thigh approaches parallel.
Push through your front foot to straighten that leg and rise.
Complete the working leg, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Keep enough sideways distance between your feet to balance comfortably.
Track your front knee over your toes and avoid letting your rear leg do most of the pushing.
